brief: Naphtha to ethylene spread in Southeast Asia during the first half of 2026

sections.title: Naphtha to Ethylene Spread in Southeast Asia, H1 2026
questions: What was the monthly naphtha to ethylene spread in Southeast Asia during the first half of 2026?
How did the spread evolve over this period?
Were there any notable events or commentary explaining changes in the spread?
sections.tool_rationale: The price series for 'Naphtha|Asia CFR|Spot' and 'Ethylene|Southeast Asia CFR|Spot' provide the data to calculate the spread and its evolution; searching documents (especially the ASEAN Petrochemical Monitor price commentary) may explain observed changes or notable events affecting the spread.
sections.unanswerable_if: If either the naphtha or ethylene price series lacks data for any month in H1 2026, or if there is no documentary commentary on price movements.

excluded.topic: Price forecast or outlook for the naphtha-ethylene spread beyond H1 2026
excluded.reason: The corpus and price commentary explicitly state that forecasts or forward expectations are not published.
